cse.title: Computer Science and Engineering Cluster
cse.snippet: CSE CLUSTER Computing Education for the Digital Future ABOUT THE CSE CLUSTER The cluster focuses on: Industry-aligned computing education Hands-on project-based learning Emerging technology exposure Innovation and research culture Students benefit from Bengaluru’s thriving technology ecosystem through internships, industry interaction, hackathons, and technical communities. The programmes are designed to help students build strong technical foundations while developing practical problem-solving and innovation skills required in modern industries. Apply for Admissions Download Brochure ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT The Department of Master of Computer Applications (MCA) at RVITM focuses on developing highly skilled software professionals equipped with advanced computing knowledge and practical programming expertise. The programme prepares students for careers in the rapidly evolving software industry by providing strong foundations in: Programming and software development Data analytics and information systems Cloud computing and distributed systems Artificial intelligence and emerging technologies WHY PURSUE MCA AT RVITM? ece.title: Department of Applied Sciences and Humanities
ece.snippet: Department of Applied Sciences and Humanities Building the academic foundation for future engineers through mathematics, physics, chemistry and interdisciplinary learning. Apply for Admission Department of Applied Sciences and Humanities Building the academic foundation for future engineers through mathematics, physics, chemistry and interdisciplinary learning. Apply for Admission ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT The Department of Applied Sciences and Humanities at RVITM plays a vital role in building the academic foundation for undergraduate engineering students. The department focuses on strengthening the scientific, analytical and communication skills that underpin engineering education. It integrates key disciplines, including:   Mathematics Physics Chemistry Communication and Humanities Through a blend of theoretical knowledge, laboratory experiments, and interdisciplinary learning, the department prepares students for advanced engineering studies across various technical domains.
